categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in steel manufacturing, producing billets from steel scrap and rolling billets into rebar. It also engages in rebar processing and logistics services. Additionally, it has expanded into new business areas including smart farming and personal protective equipment (PPE) manufacturing and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The core production involves electric furnace steelmaking using steel scrap as raw material, billet production, and rolling processes for rebar manufacturing. The company employs automation and computerized systems in rebar processing and logistics. In new ventures, it utilizes waste heat energy conversion for advanced greenhouse farming and develops PPE products with specialized materials like aramid flame-retardant fabrics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, distributors, and government procurement agencies within the domestic market. The steel products serve as essential construction materials. The PPE business targets industrial workplaces requiring safety equipment. The smart farming initiative aims at agricultural sectors focusing on energy-efficient and sustainable farming solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Busan (Shinpyeong, Noksan, Gupyeong) and Pyeongtaek in South Korea. It maintains global sales networks through subsidiaries and branches in the United States and Singapore. Its sales are predominantly domestic with minimal export activity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, converting raw steel scrap into billets and finished rebar products. It also provides downstream services such as rebar processing and logistics. The smart farming and PPE businesses represent diversification beyond traditional steel supply chain roles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include cost reduction in manufacturing, expanding market share through increased sales volume, and ensuring workplace safety. R&D focuses on sustainable growth via smart farming technologies that convert industrial waste heat into agricultural energy, development of advanced PPE products, and digital transformation including SAP HANA implementation. The company pursues ESG goals through energy efficiency and carbon emission reduction initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of steel products such as rebar, billets, and Bar-in-Coil to construction and distribution customers. Additional income comes from logistics services and rebar processing. The PPE segment generates revenue from product sales via online and offline channels. The smart farming business is currently in development with no significant revenue yet.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds the third-largest domestic rebar production capacity in South Korea, strengthened by acquiring a 70% stake in YK Steel. It competes in a mature, price-sensitive market where cost competitiveness, raw material procurement, and production efficiency are critical. Its vertical integration and diversified business lines provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.45 trillion KRW and operating profit of about 110 billion KRW, reflecting a decline from the previous year due to market contraction and raw material price fluctuations. Total assets stood at around 1.12 trillion KRW with a healthy liquidity ratio of 260% and a debt ratio of 32%. The company is a mid-to-large scale enterprise with steady growth and ongoing investments in new business areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable supply and cost competitiveness through strong scrap procurement and integrated steelmaking and rolling operations. It differentiates by providing value-added services like automated rebar processing and logistics. Its new business initiatives leverage proprietary waste heat energy conversion technology for sustainable agriculture and develop PPE products tested in real industrial environments, enhancing safety and reliability for end users.
